title: How Long Do Dental Bridges Last: Expected Lifespan Guide
seoTitle: How Long Do Dental Bridges Last? 7 to 15 Years
seoDescription: Most fixed bridges last 7 to 15 years. Learn what shortens or extends that span and how a bridge compares with an implant. Ask our Valencia team.
excerpt: Fixed bridges commonly last 7 to 15 years. Learn what shortens or extends that lifespan, how bridges compare with implants, and the care that helps them last.
keyTakeaways: A fixed dental bridge commonly lasts 7 to 15 years with good hygiene and routine care; well cared for bridges can last longer.
Gum disease, decay under the crowns, and heavy bite forces from grinding are the main reasons bridges fail early.
Preparing abutment teeth removes enamel; if the neighboring teeth are healthy, an implant avoids altering them.
Daily cleaning under the pontic, hygiene visits every 3 to 6 months, and a night guard for grinders extend bridge life.
Watch for sensitivity around an abutment, looseness, gum swelling, or decay at crown margins on an X-ray.
